question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 625. After allowing a discount of 32% on the marked price, there was a profit of Rs. 25. The profit percentage (correct to the nearest integer) is:
solution:
**Given:**

The marked price = Rs. 625

Discount = 32%

Profit = Rs. 25

**Formula used:**

C.P. = S.P. - Profit

S.P. = (100 - Discount%)/100 × M.P.

Profit% = Profit/C.P. × 100

Where, C.P. = Cost price; S.P. = Selling price; M.P. = Marked price

**Calculation:**

The selling price of the article = (100 - 32)/100 × 625 = (68/100) × 625 = Rs. 425

The cost price = 425 - 25 = Rs. 400

The percentage of profit = (25/400) × 100 = 6.25% ≈ 6% (correct to the nearest integer)

**∴ TThe profit percentage (correct to the nearest integer) is 6%**
